text.tspan: Pig production: Greenhouse gas emissions vs. cost to animal welfare

tspan.tspan: Harriet Bartlett et al. (2024). Trade-offs in the externalities of pig production are not inevitable.
Based on 91 pig production systems across the United Kingdom and Brazil. One dot equals one system.
